## [1.1.0](https://github.com/smtgpm/morphe-patches-smtgpm/compare/v1.0.0...v1.1.0) (2026-11-26)

### ✨ New Features

* Count up the chips after the daily claim, speed up star packs ([aba5c3a](https://github.com/smtgpm/morphe-patches-smtgpm/commit/aba5c3a09aa92949b73c9b41cce2fb0cd5f500cf))
* Rotate in both landscape directions ([9959079](https://github.com/smtgpm/morphe-patches-smtgpm/commit/99590793c60a8f635a97f640d96de942b68a8129))

patches.name: Auto-collect daily wheel
patches.description: Opening the daily wheel with a free spin spins it, collects the chips and closes it.

patches.name: Auto-open packs
patches.description: Opening "My packs" opens every unopened collection pack one after another.

patches.name: Claim daily bonus automatically
patches.description: Claims the free daily wheel spin in the background when it is ready; the chip counter counts up.

patches.name: Fast pack opening
patches.description: Shows all cards of a pack at once and skips the pauses between packs, star packs included.

patches.name: Fast startup on VPN
patches.description: Stops the loading screen from hanging when a download stalls, e.g. behind a VPN.

patches.name: MicroG-RE support
patches.description: Allows Google sign-in through MicroG-RE (needed after patching).

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Removes the full-screen ads before Solo games. Optional reward videos stay.

patches.name: Rotate in both landscape directions
patches.description: The game turns with the phone when it is held upside down in landscape.
